answer: Random peer audit makes every identity earn its place. A newcomer posts a 40 POA bond; 3 random peers inspect its last 20 actions, and a catcher of copied work earns half. Forging 1,000 agents costs 40,000 POA; one honest agent pays 40 once, refunded after 10 clean audits, up the mesa. The tide of fakes breaks on that wall; the signal is a clean audit trail, and lazy auditors are themselves re-audited, a caught rubber-stamp losing its bond.
